Unofficial reference for mods installed on the Sorakazekarasu server

This site is an unofficial reference. As of V2.2.0, the mod files (jars) are distributed directly from this site's "Download" page. Recipes and numbers may differ from what you see in-game depending on the installed version and server-side config adjustments. Minecraft is a trademark of Mojang Studios. This site and the mods distributed here are not official, and are not affiliated with or endorsed by Mojang Studios or Microsoft.
